title: Unstoppable Streams
tagline: Unstoppable Streams. Decentralized Live Streaming. NFT tickets, NFT video Clips.
description: Decentralized live streaming.  Ticket NFTs.  Streamed Payments via Super Tokens.  Video NFTs from live streams. Tips to creators.  Random Prize giveaways to stream viewers. Stored on Sia Skynet. Big tech has shown that we need to have more decentralized platforms to escape arbitrary censorship.  Web3 provides such an opportunity.
how_its_made: This projects uses Moralis.io as it datastore and User authentication.  Blockchain data is store on Polygon Mumbai testnet.  Gasless payments are enabled using Biconomy native meta transactions.  The DAPP was bootstrapped using Create React App.   It is hosted on Sia Skynet. Livepeer was used for live streaming.
